newsitem.title: ITALY: Warm reception for Italy 7-yr 1 bln Sfr bond.
newsitem.headline: Warm reception for Italy 7-yr 1 bln Sfr bond.

text.p: Italy's one billion Swiss franc bond launched on Swiss markets on Tuesday received a warm reception, syndicate sources said.
The bond, which matures on July 1, 2004, pays an annual 3.25 percent coupon, 15 basis points below three month Libor. The issue price is 102.25 (gross of the 2.5 percent fees).
The subscription offer will last until Friday June 20 and the bond will be listed on the Swiss exchange starting on Monday June 23. Settlement has been set on July 1.
"The bond has received very good reception. It always depends on the market but I think a fair amount of the bonds have been sold and placed," a source at lead manager CSFB said.
"This is the first sovereign issue of this size on the Swiss market this year and there's therefore a lot of Swiss demand for this type of product which has not been satisfied," a market source said.
He added that the Swiss market "allows combining a good duration (seven years) with low interest rates".
